Context: Time-limit:

## Time-limit:  
1. Maximum time-limit of fifteen days is being prescribed for
2. sanction and payment of an advance from the Fund.
3. In case of emergencies like illness, etc., the time-limit is restricted
2. to seven days.
3. For all the above cases of advance, no documentary proof is required. A simple declaration explaining the reasons for advance would be sufficient. - GIDs (1-A) to (1-C), Rule 12.
